additional_info.subject: ID0480083-DC/Si-D/BE- [Y2 / S6 313717534002] Charger Connectivity Issue CRM:03289000621
additional_info.body:
Hi Bart, good morning.
I would like to request a favor from you, I'm currently part of the Integrations team and we are trying to find as much information as possible for everyone to have access. In this case, information about your ELMS, for this can you please fill in the questionaire that I send in attachment? This would enable us to demonstrate to other regions or customers, which ELMS are known to be working.
For your problem, I found that the ELMS is indeed not communicating with the SID. As you can see from the photo, I can connect to the ELMS myself and I am not able to ping 192.168.1.144.
For starters, I would check if the device used to connect the Ethernet Cable is FA13.
Second is to make sure the ELMS is connected to the network with this IP address.
